implementation_notes: Supplier publishes an OpenAPI contract and versioned events; consumers generate (or pact) the contract and the supplier verifies it in its own build. Use Avro/Protobuf schema compatibility checks plus deprecation metadata in the schema registry.
idiom_name: OpenAPI + schema registry with compatibility checks
pitfalls: Backward compatibility configured as FULL, so every field addition breaks consumers
Consumers each building bespoke client adapters against the supplier's API
